document.notes: The SSA issues this form; it is not an IRS form and has no irs.gov form PDF. The box layout reproduced here is the specimen printed in IRS Publication 915 (2025), 'Appendix - Social Security Benefit Statement'. Box 5 is the reportable figure and equals box 3 minus box 4 - see the aggregate ssa1099.5. What this document STATES (net benefits, 1040 line 6a) is not what the return REPORTS (the taxable part, line 6b): line 6b is computed by a worksheet whose provisional income already includes half of these benefits, so it is modelled as computed, never routed.

extraction.note: prebuilt-tax.us.1099SSA returns boxes 3-6 and never the description of amount in box 3 and box 4 (measured: 2 stored reads, every one of the box 3/4 description lines not returned, 2026-10-03). Those lines carry the Medicare Part B, C and D premiums deducted from benefits, which reach Schedule A as medical expenses (spec 080 T059, CPA case 2). Read by the declared custom model over every box this document declares, so the premium block is read with the figures it explains.

custom.reads: a Form SSA-1099, Social Security Benefit Statement, including the 'Description of Amount in Box 3' and 'Description of Amount in Box 4' blocks. Those lines print no box number of their own, and each IS a declared box: report every one of them in the section under the box id the list gives it (for example a line of Medicare premiums deducted from benefits under 3-medicare-premiums, Part C under 3-medicare-part-c, Part D under 3-medicare-part-d, paid by check or direct deposit under 3-paid-by-check-or-direct-deposit), never as an other figure.
